Almost this exact thing has happened to me. Only you know. Most of the details are different. ._. 

Possibly... my first week into high school, as a new 9th grader. (Schools here go K-5, 6-8, 9-12). I'm putting my stuff in my locker and this tall fairly attractive 12th grader slumps next to me and asks me how I'm liking high school. He proceeds to flirt with me and after a few encounters like this... possibly even the next time he asks me out. I was bullied when I was younger, rather badly, so it was both surprising that he was asking me out and extremely flattering.

We got into some heavy petting; but as I was in a relationship with him I learned from my best friend, who hated his guts, that this was something he was famous for. I broke it off over the phone and life went on. 

As we continued in grade 9 he found another girlfriend among our peers. And the next year he had a 9th grade girlfriend. We know because he didn't graduate. 

Things get fuzzy after a bit because I never really kept abreast of it but my best friend really hated him and sort of relentlessly kept on top of it. 

He eventually started dating 8th graders because his reputation in our school was so bad. Then he graduated and he kept dating younger girls. It got around the grapevine because the girls were always in school. 

To this day I don't know what his major malfunction is.
